Ok.
1
Rudders must be removed and the lower portion must be renewed to proper dimension. They are
worn to the point of failure and vibrate badly.
2
We bought pumps and pulleys we can install but I am referencing the gear in the aft
compartment that is the hydraulic actuator and linkage for the rudders
3
The cylinders were damaged at sea due to improper installation and subsequent damage from a
broken fitting. The ramp was secured with a safety strap but still pulled the top sealing portion out
of the cylinder.
I discussed this with Roy and it was decided to weld solid the leaking and damaged portions
rendering the cylinders unserviceable in the future but functional for the present.
The fit of the mounts needs to be remedied at this time. The cylinders work now but are not
repairable. Evaluation while being removed to correct and improve the mounting is necessary at a
minimum.
